prompt: gawk debugger eval command restricted statements
answer:
In the `gawk` debugger, `eval` accepts AWK statements, but `return` is not allowed in the current evaluation context. Consequently, evaluating a user-defined function containing `return` fails:

```text
gawk> eval "print isnumeric(\"hello\")"
error: `return' not allowed in current context; statement ignored
```

Built-in function calls work:

```text
gawk> eval "print length(\"hello\")"
5
```

The `eval` command is described as evaluating “awk statement(s).” ([Google Groups](https://groups.google.com/g/comp.lang.awk/c/5aUCL_KVuLM), [gawk source](https://github.com/perplexityai/gawk/blob/main/command.y))
